message.content: {"basis": "The dashboard is a choropleth where fill color encodes the risk index. The vertical legend maps the pale-yellow top to 'High' (100) and the dark-maroon bottom to 'Low' (0). Comparing the three candidate states: Illinois (IL) is filled pale yellow, matching the top of the scale (highest risk); Delaware (DE) is filled orange, matching the middle of the scale; and Kansas (KS) is filled dark maroon, matching the bottom of the scale (lowest risk). Since the routing criterion is the highest-risk state, IL is the correct selection." , "option_label": "Open Illinois (IL) risk detail for priority follow-up"}
